title: Motion for an extension of time within which to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
June 18, 2025
Honorable Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street, NE
Washington, DC 20543-0001
 Re: First Choice Women’s Resource Centers, Inc v. Platkin
  Case No. 24-781
Dear Mr. Harris:
Pursuant to Rule 30.4, the parties respectfully request an extension of the
briefing schedule in the above-captioned case. The petition for a writ of certiorari
was granted on June 16, 2025. Petitioner’s opening brief on the merits, and the joint
appendix, are currently due July 31, 2025. Respondent’s brief on the merits is due
September 2, 2025.
The parties request that the due dates for each of their briefs be extended
seven days, making the Petitioner’s brief and joint appendix due on August 7, 2025
and Respondent’s brief due on September 15.  This extension of time is requested to
accommodate professional and personal obligations.
Respectfully Submitted,
s/Erin M. Hawley
Erin M. Hawley
Counsel for Petitioner

PROOF OF SERVICE

I, Erin M. Hawley, counsel for Petitioner and a member of the Bar of this Court,
certify that on this 18th day of June, 2025, I caused the Motion for Extension of Time
for Merits Briefing to be served by electronic means on the following:

  Jeremy M. Feigenbaum
  Solicitor General
  Office of the New Jersey Attorney General
  R.J. Hughes Justice Complex
  25 Market Street
  Trenton, NJ 08625
  jeremy.feigenbaum@njoag.gov

 I further certify that all parties required to be served have been served.


 Executed on June 18, 2025

       s/Erin M. Hawley
 ERIN M. HAWLEY
